visual_result: PASS — Rose and Damascena render as clean condensed Didone letterforms with intact counters, hairlines and serifs on two straight baselines. The shard output is gone.

iou_gate.interpretation: NOT certified. The measurement compares two INDEPENDENTLY flattened rasters (cubic at 12 steps vs quadratic at 8 steps) at 61-73 px cap height, so most of the deficit is flattening and rasterisation noise rather than conversion damage — a one-pixel edge difference costs several percent of area at this size. The visual proof shows no missing contour, bowl or counter. Certification requires re-measuring at high resolution with a single shared flattener; that was not done.

why_hard_stop: The mandate requires per-glyph IoU >= 0.995 before inspections run. That gate is not met as measured, so the two typography inspections were correctly NOT run and the review package was not built.
